name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka joined motorsport after a long career in general HR, looking for a more dynamic and challenging environment. He spent years in corporate environments, but his lifelong passion for racing cars drew him to seek a position where he could combine his professional skills with his personal interests. Kenji's approach to HR is rooted in fairness, efficiency, and a strong belief in identifying and nurturing talent.

He believes in creating a structured and supportive work environment, even within the high-pressure world of motorsport. While relatively new to the specific demands of racing, Kenji's dedication to process and his commitment to continuous improvement make him a valuable asset to any team aiming to foster a positive and productive workplace. His ambition is to implement best HR practices and contribute to the team's success beyond the racetrack.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a slightly stern expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously taking notes in meetings.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when thinking deeply.
Insists on punctuality and adherence to schedules.
